lines.speaker: Codex
lines.text: Year 2060. The last true copies are gone. You are a scribe, sent to see it with your own eyes and write it down faithfully.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
